articles.title: Planes Across the U.S. Stop Flying After Rare Nationwide Ground Stop
articles.summary: The FAA ordered a rare nationwide ground stop on Friday after a communications problem, halting flights across the country; officials said it was not tied to an attack and everyone was safe.

articles.title: Starship Reaches Orbit, but Its Booster Misses the Big Catch
articles.summary: SpaceX's Starship reached orbit on Friday, but its booster malfunctioned and fell into the Gulf of Mexico instead of being caught at the launch pad; the spacecraft will try to return to the pad on Saturday.

articles.title: Alaska Picks Its Youngest Governor Ever
articles.summary: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins, 37, won Alaska's governor race and will be the state's youngest governor ever; he takes office on December 7.
